key_insight: The paper introduces an OWL 2 DL ontology that standardizes how machine learning interatomic potentials are described, linked to training data, and compared across studies.
engineering_relevance: It improves reproducibility and benchmarking for MLIPs by making method, dataset provenance, and hyperparameter metadata machine-readable and interoperable.
method: Built a three-module ontology: Method, Training Data, and Benchmark.
Connected MLIP metadata to existing materials and ML schemas, including DFT provenance.
Added formal axioms and property chains to enforce completeness and consistency.
evidence_signal: The ontology was tested with competency questions on a 20-paper seeded knowledge graph, OWL reasoning, and comparison against existing ontologies.
watch_item: Adoption may depend on how easily researchers can map diverse legacy MLIP files and paper metadata into the ontology without manual curation.
paper_title: An Ontology for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
